usage: agentware team [-h] [--format {text,json}] {list,create,register} ...

positional arguments:
  {list,create,register}
    list                list teams + members from teams/registry.json
    create              scaffold a NEW team folder + register the caller
    register            JOIN an existing team (adds the caller)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --format {text,json}  output format (default: text)
